title: Beyond Nash Equilibrium: Bounded Rationality of LLMs and humans in Strategic Decision-making

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM action sequences and choice distributions in behavioral game theory paradigms (Rock-Paper-Scissors and Prisoner's Dilemma) to measure deviations from theoretically optimal Nash equilibrium, identifying human-like heuristics, frequency bias, and outcome-conditioned transition patterns (e.g., Win-Stay/Lose-Change).
